Public gazzasat/huawei-cpe code demonstrates a net-mode 00 write on H112-370 10.0.3.1(H330SP60C21), so that inference does not establish absence of every write surface. LTE-only and saved mixed-mode recovery require fresh complete native configuration and exact readback under the selected conditional protocol. No exact-firmware LTE/restore cycle is physically qualified here.
